# Rimshot

> Rimshot is a free metronome for music that changes tempo and time signature. Build a piece from groups of measures, each with its own tempo and time signature, then loop the bars around any change, with a count-off between passes, until the transition is automatic. It's on iPhone and in closed beta on Android. There are no ads, in-app purchases, subscriptions or accounts, and nothing leaves the phone.

Rimshot is for pit musicians, section leaders and anyone whose music changes tempo or meter. It has three modes:

- Show: measure groups with their own count, tempo and time signature, tempo ramps (accelerando and ritardando), accent patterns that accent, play or silence each beat, 1 to 6 subdivisions, section letters A to Z, looping from any measure or section with a two-measure count-off, and a two-measure count-in. Shows can be shared as a link or QR code that plays in any browser.
- Met: a single-tempo metronome from 10 to 400 BPM with tap tempo and background playback.
- Tuner: note name and cents readout, with an adjustable reference pitch (A4 = 440 Hz by default). Audio is never recorded, saved or sent anywhere.

## Guides

- [Practice the transitions](https://getrimshot.com/tempo-changes/): why tempo and time signature changes fall apart, and how to loop them
- [Rimshot for musical theater](https://getrimshot.com/musical-theater/): vamps, bars of 2/4, ritardandos and sending a number to the whole pit
- [Rimshot for marching band](https://getrimshot.com/marching-band/): building a field show, gap clicks, and sending a show to the section
